For each $A<\infty $, if $Q(A)$ bounds the scalar curvature of $Q_nG_n$ on $B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,A)$, then there are $t'_0(A)>0$ and $Q'(A)<\infty $, with $Q'(A)$ depending only on $Q(A)$, such that eventually $B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,A)\times (-t'_0(A),0]$ embeds compatibly in ${\mathcal M}_n$ and has scalar curvature at most $Q'(A)$.

\label{cnnbhd2}

For each $A<\infty$, if $Q(A)$ bounds the scalar curvature of
$Q_nG_n$ on $B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,A)$, then there are $t'_0(A)>0$ and
$Q'(A)<\infty$, with $Q'(A)$ depending only on $Q(A)$, such that eventually
$B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,A)\times(-t'_0(A),0]$ embeds compatibly in
${\mathcal M}_n$ and has scalar curvature at most $Q'(A)$.
\end{corollary}
